integrity: Finite trace and F2 boundary ranks are reproduced by two standalone programs; the all-order part invokes the published Smetaniuk/Evans partial-Latin completion theorem. The review does not claim external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the degree-at-most-n-minus-one characterization is asserted uniformly in n. The complete shattering complex and mod-two homology are determined at n=3 only. Integral torsion, homotopy type, and priority among unindexed finite computations remain open.
title: Small-support shattering of Latin squares and the order-three incidence complex
